scope: Original initialization, launch and declared physical Lock approaches earn Ninja multiball through its three original locks and timed AddMultiball queue. Three declared scoop approaches enter one chooser; original keys select and confirm under a burst. All three use the original 3000ms ejection and 350ms queue; two subsequent approaches during the active mode use ordinary ejection. Instrumentation only increments counters inside original handlers and reads GetBalls IDs. No qualification/counter setters, direct Hit calls, RNG, clock, timer, expected body, allocator or rescue input. The shared player chooser correction is explicitly installed in the native reference. This is controlled physical coverage, not ordinary-input-only play or exact trajectory comparison.

metadata.scope: Exact committed master VPX and browser snapshot, including its continuous HTML music player. No injected table instrumentation or chooser correction. Engine cache is read only. Individual comparison probes declare any observers or external inputs separately.

instrumentation:
Dim EarnedQLockReleases,EarnedQScoopHits,EarnedQScoopKicks,EarnedQStarts
EarnedQLockReleases=0:EarnedQScoopHits=0:EarnedQScoopKicks=0:EarnedQStarts=0
Function EarnedQIDs()
 Dim all,ball,result
 result="":all=GetBalls()
 For Each ball In all:If ball.ID>=3 Then result=result&CStr(ball.ID)&","
 Next
 EarnedQIDs=result
End Function
Sub ExitLock
    EarnedQLockReleases=EarnedQLockReleases+1
    SwordEffect 3
    PLaySoundAt "fx_kicker", lock
    Lock.kick 180, 3
End Sub
Sub HellHouse_Hit
    EarnedQScoopHits=EarnedQScoopHits+1
    If bSkillShotReady Then ResetSkillShotTimer_Timer
    ' check for modes
    StopCombo
    Addscore 25000
    HellHouse.destroyball
    BallsinHole = BallsInHole + 1
    li056.State = 0
    Flashforms flasher012, 800, 50, 0
    ' check modes
    If li041.State Then 'weapon jackpot
        li041.State = 0
        DMD CL(0, "SUPPLIES JACKPOT"), CL(1, "1 MILLION"), "", eNone, eBlink, eNone, 2000, True, "fanfare"
        Addscore 1000000
        RelitWeapons
    End If
    If li038.State Then 'extra ball
        li038.State = 0
        AwardExtraBall
    End If
    If li037.State Then 'mystery
        li037.State = 0
        StartMystery
        Exit Sub                  'mystery will kick the ball out after it is finished
    End If
    If bChooseBattle Then Exit Sub 'do nothing if you already are selecing a battle, due to multiball
    If bMechSuitMBSJackpot Then
        SuperJackpot(CurrentPLayer) = MechMBJackpot(CurrentPlayer) * 6
        AwardSuperJackpot
        MechMBJackpot(CurrentPlayer) = MechMBJackpot(CurrentPlayer) + 1000000 'increase by 1 million
        ContinueMechSuitMB
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If bMechSuitMBLight(CurrentPlayer) Then 'Start Mech Suit Multiball
        StartMechSuitMB
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If bBattleReady AND bMechSuitMBStarted = False then
        StartChooseBattle 'choose battle will kick out the ball after choosing a battle
        bBattleReady = False
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If bEndBattleJackpot Then
        bEndBattleJackpot = False
        Jackpot(CurrentPLayer) = 3000000:AwardJackpot
    End If
    ' Nothing left to do, so kick out the ball
    Flashforms li070, 1500, 50, 0
    vpmtimer.addtimer 1500, "kickBallOut '"
End Sub
Sub kickBallOut
    If BallsinHole> 0 Then
    EarnedQScoopKicks=EarnedQScoopKicks+1
        BallsinHole = BallsInHole - 1
        '    PlaySoundAt "fx_popper", HellHouse
        PlaySoundAt SoundFXDOF("fx_popper", 111, DOFPulse, DOFcontactors), HellHouse
        HellHouse.CreateSizedBallWithMass BallSize / 2, BallMass
        HellHouse.kick 164, 12, 0
        Flashforms li070, 500, 50, 0
        Flashforms flasher012, 500, 50, 0
        vpmtimer.addtimer 350, "kickBallOut '" 'kick out the rest of the balls, if any
    End If
End Sub
Sub StartBattle(n)
    EarnedQStarts=EarnedQStarts+1
    DMDFlush
    TurnOffTeamUpLights
    Battle(CurrentPlayer, 0) = n
    Battle(CurrentPlayer, n) = 2 '0 battle not started, 1 battle finished, 2 battle started
    If bFirstBattle(CurrentPlayer) Then
        AttackPower = 2
    Else
        AttackPower = 1 'the battles are now double as hard to complete
    End If
    TurnOffArrows
    ChangeSong
    Select Case Battle(CurrentPlayer, 0)
        Case 1 'Juggernaut
            DMD "", CL(1, "TARGETS + LIT SHOTS"), "d_finni_presents", eNone, eNone, eNone, 3000, True, "vo_shootflashingshots"
            If LifeLeft(CurrentPlayer, 1)> 6 Then
                LightSeqDPtargets.Play SeqRandom, 40, , 4000
            Else
                BattleLights(2) = 2:BattleLights(5) = 2
            End If
            Flasher003.visible = 1
            OpenGates
            ChangeGi Red
            ChangeGiIntensity 1.3
        Case 2 'Mystique
            DMD "", CL(1, "SHOOT WHITE SHOTS"), "d_finni_invitations", eNone, eNone, eNone, 3000, True, "vo_shoot-mystique"
            BattleLights(4) = 2
            Flasher004.visible = 1
            OpenGates
            ChangeGi Purple
            ChangeGiIntensity 1.5
        Case 3 'Sabretooth
            DMD "", CL(1, "LOOPS AND BUMPERS"), "d_finni_balloons", eNone, eNone, eNone, 3000, True, "vo_shoot-sabretooth"
            BattleLights(1) = 2:BattleLights(6) = 2
            li001.State = 2
            Flasher005.visible = 1
            CloseGates
            ChangeGi Amber
            ChangeGiIntensity 1.3
        Case 4 'T-Rex
            DMD "", CL(1, "SHOOT GREEN SHOTS"), "d_finni_decorations", eNone, eNone, eNone, 3000, True, "vo_shootgreenshots-trex"
            Select case RndNbr(6)
                Case 1:BattleLights(1) = 2:BattleLights(2) = 2
                Case 2:BattleLights(2) = 2:BattleLights(4) = 2
                Case 3:BattleLights(4) = 2:BattleLights(5) = 2
                Case 4:BattleLights(5) = 2:BattleLights(6) = 2
                Case 5:BattleLights(6) = 2:BattleLights(3) = 2
                Case 6:BattleLights(3) = 2:BattleLights(1) = 2
            End Select
            Flasher002.visible = 1
            OpenGates
            ChangeGi Green
            ChangeGiIntensity 2
        Case 5 'Megalodon
            DMD "", CL(1, "SHOOT FLASHING SHOT"), "d_finni_baking", eNone, eNone, eNone, 3000, True, "vo_shootblueshots-megalodon"
            For each x in aArrows
                SetLightColor x, blue, 1
            Next
            BattleLights(1) = 1
            BattleLights(2) = 1
            BattleLights(3) = 1
            BattleLights(4) = 1
            BattleLights(5) = 1
            BattleLights(6) = 1
            Select case RndNbr(6)
                Case 1:BattleLights(1) = 2
                Case 2:BattleLights(2) = 2
                Case 3:BattleLights(3) = 2
                Case 4:BattleLights(4) = 2
                Case 5:BattleLights(5) = 2
                Case 6:BattleLights(6) = 2
            End Select
            OpenGates
            ChangeGi Blue
            ChangeGiIntensity 2
        Case 6 'Sauron
            DMD "", CL(1, "SHOOT GREEN SHOTS"), "d_finni_pinata", eNone, eNone, eNone, 3000, True, "vo_shootgreenshots-sauron"
            AddMultiball 2
            BattleLights(2) = 2
            BattleLights(5) = 2
            OpenGates
            ChangeGi Teal
            ChangeGiIntensity 2
        Case 7 'MrSinister
            DMD "", CL(1, "SHOOT FLASHING SHOTS"), "d_finni_party", eNone, eNone, eNone, 3000, True, "vo_shootflashingshots-ifyoudare"
            Select case RndNbr(4)
                Case 1:BattleLights(1) = 2
                Case 2:BattleLights(4) = 2
                Case 3:BattleLights(6) = 2
                Case 4:BattleLights(3) = 2
            End Select
            AddMultiball 1
            OpenGates
            MrSinisterTimer.Interval = 120 + dazzlerValue
            MrSinisterTimer.Enabled = 1
            ChangeGi Blue
            ChangeGiIntensity 2
    End Select
    Flashforms li070, 3000, 50, 0
    vpmtimer.addtimer 3000, "KickBallOut '"
End Sub
